name: custom-mcps
description: Standalone MCP servers by jahirtrap (pixel art, sound effects, conventions, translations, study, 3D design, interface contrast, mod workspaces), each installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: buildkit
plugins.description: Design low-poly 3D structures by data: principles, references, spec, iso and silhouette preview, Godot def.

plugins.name: devkit
plugins.description: Development conventions plus the checks that verify them: commits, hardcoded tokens, spacing, format, duplication and comments. The core rules reach every session at its start and after each compaction, and an edit that adds comments gets a notice.

plugins.name: i18n
plugins.description: Keep translation locales in sync, complete and consistent (read-only): key diff, completeness, placeholders, unused keys.

plugins.name: modkit
plugins.description: Inspect and validate multiloader Minecraft mod workspaces (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge): list, inspect, loader sync, structure and JSON checks.

plugins.name: pixelart
plugins.description: Draw, inspect and verify pixel art by data, any size, with an upscaled preview you can actually read.

plugins.name: sfx
plugins.description: Synthesize sound effects (.ogg) by data, any kind, with a waveform image to check them at a glance.

plugins.name: study
plugins.description: Academic study work by data: anti-AI writing checks, grammar check through LanguageTool, editable Word and PowerPoint on the institution's template, APA citations, reference links checked with an archived fallback, concept maps, typeset PDFs and decks, free-image sourcing, multi-area workspaces.

plugins.name: uikit
plugins.description: Interface design measured, not argued: design tokens, the color pairs the code really uses, WCAG contrast, and a mockup checked against the design the app's code uses.
